title: Canonical notation for formal chart geometric regularity
statement: For a scheme map y:W -> Spec Z[R] and a chart map h:R -> Q, let Z be its toric pullback. At a geometric point z of Z, define A to be the canonical geometric strict henselization of W at its projected point, baseMap:Spec A -> W its structural map, and alpha:R -> A by the toric-coordinate map on global sections. Define tensorRight:Z[Q] -> A tensor_Z[R] Z[Q] by the right tensor inclusion. For a commutative monoid T define rank T to be the extended-natural rational rank of its group completion, viewed in WithBot ENat. For a local ring A, sharp chart a and Boolean mixed, HasCompletion is exactly the monomial-compatible completed field presentation when mixed=false, or the Cohen hypersurface presentation with congruence modulo all chart monomials and all parameters when mixed=true. ModelDimensions B T J mixed says that a single nonzero complete regular local coefficient ring D gives the completed pair (Bhat,J Bhat) as D[[T]] with its monomial ideal, or its parameter hypersurface with its image ideal. It includes regularity of Bhat/J Bhat and the two additive dimension formulas dim Bhat+e=dim D+rank T and dim(Bhat/J Bhat)+e=dim D, e=0 or 1. For a geometric point t of Spec B, strictBase t is the ring map dual to the canonical strict-local structural morphism, and strictIdeal t J is its ideal extension. These are aliases, ring maps, and predicates only; there is no assertion of their geometric properties. Definitions of tensor charts, complete models, log structures, strict localization, and Krull dimension are those of the statement dependencies.
